Name: Advanced Fruit Tree Framework (AFTF)
Author: Larvuk
Description:
[size=4][b]AFTF is a deep rework of the code behind the fruit tree system, allowing the edition of behaviours that were hardcoded before.[/b][/size]

[size=3][b][u]As a player[/u], you can:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]use AFTF config to change the generic behaviour of your fruit trees (number of fruits produced each day, radius of blocked growth, maximum number of fruits in a tree, number of days to mature).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]install AFTF mod packs adding trees with specific behaviours.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b][u]As a modder[/u], you can create or edit fruit trees in deep and strange ways to make them unique. [/b][/size][b]Features include:[/b]
[list]
[*]total control on the [b]amount, nature, position and quality[/b] of the items produced by your trees.[/*]
[*]change their [b]planting conditions, growth time[/b], and behaviour & drops when destroyed.[/*]
[*][b]complex condition system[/b] allowing you to change any behaviour depending on the season, location, weather, installed mods, config from other mods, character level, random values, and more.[/*]
[*]make [b]evolutive trees[/b], able to get better, evolve, wither, die or whatever.[/*]
[/list][i][b][size=4]See the articles for full documentation.[/size][/b][/i]

Images from the gallery include [i]Cornucopia[/i]'s Durian Tree, [i]Kalash More Fruit Trees[/i]'s Azuravian Tree (the dead version from our collab on FTR), and the Antipodean Apple Tree from an example pack you might see sometime. The images also picture [i]Vibrant Pastoral[/i], [i]Simple Foliage[/i] and [i]Elle's Cuter Grass[/i].
A big thanks to Hayato2236 for both motivation and testing.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

My mod Fruit Tree Reforged (FTR) has be rewritten as an AFTF pack, so it's fully compatible starting with its 2.0 version. Older versions of FTR are not.

AFTF uses Harmony and alters methods from the FruitTree class. Mods that aren't affecting fruit trees should all be compatible.

Full list of Patched methods (mods affecting the same methods might or might not be compatible):
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.TryAddFruit[/font][/size][size=1] (deep prefix)
[font=Courier New]FruitTree.draw[/font] (prefix + postfix overriding the draw method)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.dayUpdate[/font][/size][size=1] (postfix overridding the growth process)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.performToolAction[/font][/size][size=1] (deep prefix)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.performUseAction[/font][/size][size=1] (prefix always returning false)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.tickUpdate[/font][/size][size=1] (prefix overriding the falling process)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.IsGrowthBlocked [/font][/size][size=1](prefix overriding the original method for trees affected by a content pack)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.IsTooCloseFromAnotherTree[/font][/size][size=1] (postfix)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.loadSprite[/font][/size][size=1] (prefix returning false for trees with a modified sprite)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]FruitTree.GetSpriteRowNumber[/font][/size][size=1] (postfix)[/size]
[size=1][font=Courier New]Object.placementAction[/font][/size][size=1] (prefix returning false for trees with a modified planting condition)[/size]
